import copy, json
from work import evaluate
cases = [
 ({'declared':['z','a','z'],'saved':{'a':{'kind':'file','meta':{'b':2,'a':1}},'z':[1,2]},'current':{'a':{'meta':{'a':1,'b':2},'kind':'file'},'z':[1,3]}},{},{'needs_review':True,'changed':['z']}),
 ({'declared':['a','b'],'saved':{'a':None,'b':{'kind':'file','hash':'old'}},'current':{'a':None,'b':{'kind':'file','hash':'new'}}},{'ignored':['b','b']},{'needs_review':False,'changed':[]}),
 ({'declared':['gone'],'saved':{'gone':{'kind':'missing'}},'current':{}},{},{'needs_review':False,'changed':[]}),
 ({'declared':['x'],'saved':{'x':{'kind':'file','parts':[1,2]}},'current':{'x':{'kind':'file','parts':[2,1]}}},{},{'needs_review':True,'changed':['x']})
]
for request, policy, expected in cases:
    request_before, policy_before = copy.deepcopy(request), copy.deepcopy(policy)
    actual = evaluate(request, policy)
    assert actual == expected, (actual, expected)
    assert request == request_before and policy == policy_before
print('independent boundary cases passed:', len(cases))
